items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009

ctx.x: In watching those people, at the Earle Theater, did you say to yourself that’s what I want to do?

Oh I was in love with people like Sarah Vaughan and Billie Holiday. You know they were some of the most beautiful people I ever saw in my life. I would just sit there and just look at them and just be completely fascinated by them. And my uncle, he played © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

with like Jimmy Heath and John Coltrane and all those guys in Philadelphia. And they used to have sessions in the house. But I didn’t really know who they were until I grew up. But he used to tell me that they used to come around Benny Golson and them, they used to come around and they used to play in the living room and sometimes they would put me out because they was doing things they didn’t want me to see them doing.
